disclosure.title: Certification & Disclosure Policy
disclosure.summary: What Atlantic Gems states about every stone, piece and watch it sells or appraises, and how it says so.

sections.heading: Our commitment
paragraphs: We describe every item accurately, in plain language, and in writing. Where we know something, we say it. Where we do not know something, we say that too. We do not guess at treatment, origin or authenticity, and we do not let a buyer assume more than we have stated.

sections.heading: Natural and laboratory-grown
paragraphs: Every quotation, invoice and appraisal states whether a stone is natural or laboratory-grown. Laboratory-grown stones are never described using the name of a natural stone alone; the words laboratory-grown appear with the name.
If a stone has not been tested and we cannot confirm its nature, it is described as untested and priced accordingly, or not sold.

sections.heading: Treatments and enhancements
paragraphs: Many gemstones on the market are treated or enhanced. We disclose every treatment we are aware of, such as heating, clarity enhancement, fracture filling, irradiation, coating or dyeing, on the quotation and the invoice.
Where a treatment status is unknown, the item is described as treatment not determined. We do not describe a stone as untreated unless an independent laboratory report supports that description.

sections.heading: Origin
paragraphs: Geographic origin is stated only when it is supported by an independent laboratory report or by documentation from our supplier that we are willing to show you. Otherwise the item is described as origin not determined. We do not attach origin stories to stones.

sections.heading: Laboratory reports and certification
paragraphs: We do not issue laboratory grading reports. When a stone is accompanied by a report from an independent gemmological laboratory, we name the laboratory and quote the report number, and we provide the report or a copy with the stone.

A laboratory report is that laboratory's opinion on the date it was issued. If you would like a report where none exists, ask us; where it is practical, submission to an independent laboratory can be arranged at cost with your written agreement before the stone is sent.

sections.heading: Weights, measurements and grading
paragraphs: Carat weights of loose stones are measured and stated to two decimal places. Weights of mounted stones are estimated from measurements and are labelled as estimates.
Colour, clarity and cut descriptions made by us are our professional opinion and are labelled as such. They are not a substitute for an independent laboratory report.

sections.heading: Metals
paragraphs: Precious metal content is stated as marked on the item or as tested by us, and the description says which. Plated or filled items are described as plated or filled.

sections.heading: Watches
paragraphs: Brands and models available are subject to current stock. We are not an authorized dealer of any watch manufacturer unless we state so in writing for a specific brand.

We make no statement about a watch's authenticity, service history or condition until we have examined it. Statements are then made in writing, and any part that is not original is identified where we can identify it.

sections.heading: Appraisals
paragraphs: An appraisal is a written opinion of value for a stated purpose on a stated date. It describes the item, the basis of valuation and the purpose, and it is signed. It is not an offer to buy, and it is not a guarantee of any future sale price.

sections.heading: Pre-owned and consigned items
paragraphs: Items that have been previously owned are described as pre-owned, with their condition noted. Items we sell on consignment are described on the same basis as our own stock, and the disclosures above apply to them equally.

sections.heading: If we get something wrong
paragraphs: If we learn that a description we gave was incorrect, we tell the buyer promptly and offer a remedy, which may include correction of the documents, adjustment of price, or return and refund.

sections.heading: Questions
paragraphs: Questions about this policy or about any item can be sent to support@atlanticgems.ca.

wholesale.title: Wholesale & Trade Terms
wholesale.summary: Terms that apply to trade buyers purchasing stones and goods from Atlantic Gems, and to items placed with us on memo or consignment.

sections.heading: Who these terms apply to
paragraphs: These terms apply to businesses that have been given access to our trade pricing and to anyone purchasing from us as a trade buyer. Private clients purchase under the terms stated on their individual quotation.

sections.heading: Access and confidentiality
paragraphs: Trade access is granted to a business, not an individual, and the access phrase must not be shared outside that business. Trade pricing, parcel lists and availability are confidential and may not be published or forwarded without our written consent. We may withdraw access at any time.

sections.heading: Quotations
paragraphs: All prices are in Canadian dollars and exclude applicable taxes, shipping and insurance unless the quotation says otherwise. Quotations are valid for 7 days from the date issued and are subject to prior sale. A quotation becomes an order when we confirm it in writing.

sections.heading: Taxes
paragraphs: Applicable Canadian taxes, including HST where it applies, are shown on the invoice. Buyers outside Canada are responsible for any import duties, taxes and brokerage fees in their own country.

sections.heading: Payment
paragraphs: Goods are released on receipt of payment in full unless the invoice states other terms. Orders for stones or pieces procured specifically for a buyer require a deposit of 50 percent before we source the item, with the balance due before release. Deposits on procured-to-order items are not refundable once the item has been secured on the buyer's behalf.
Accepted payment methods are stated on the invoice. We do not store card numbers.

sections.heading: Memo and approval
paragraphs: Items sent on memo remain the property of Atlantic Gems until paid for in full. From delivery until return or payment, the recipient is responsible for the items and for insuring them for the value stated on the memo. Memo items must be returned, unaltered and in the same packaging, within 7 days of receipt unless a different period is agreed in writing.

sections.heading: Shipping and risk
paragraphs: We ship by insured courier with signature on delivery. Risk passes to the buyer on delivery. Shipping and insurance are charged at cost unless included in the quotation. Buyers may arrange their own insured collection by agreement.

sections.heading: Inspection and returns
paragraphs: Please inspect goods on receipt. Stock items may be returned within 5 business days of delivery if they are unaltered, unmounted and in their original sealed packaging, and if you tell us within that period that they are coming back. Items that have been set, cut, polished or otherwise worked, and items procured to order, cannot be returned except where our description was incorrect.

sections.heading: Consignment sale
paragraphs: If you place an item with us for sale on consignment, we sign a written consignment agreement before the item is offered. The agreement records the item's description and condition at intake, the reserve price below which we will not sell, the commission payable to us, the consignment period, and who insures the item while it is in our custody.
We settle with you within 14 days of receiving cleared payment from the buyer. Unsold items are returned at the end of the consignment period in the condition recorded at intake.

sections.heading: Disclosure
paragraphs: Every sale is subject to our Certification & Disclosure Policy. Trade buyers are responsible for passing the disclosures we make on to their own customers.

sections.heading: Export and compliance
paragraphs: Buyers are responsible for complying with the laws that apply to them, including any import, export and resale requirements in their own jurisdiction. We may ask for business identification before granting trade access or releasing goods.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update these terms; the version published on our website at the time an order is confirmed applies to that order. Questions can be sent to support@atlanticgems.ca.
